title: What changes when a grazer arrives
question: What changes in the garden when two Amoebae arrive?
intervention: At 120 seconds, copy the garden. In copy B only, add two Amoebae in the nearest open cells to the sugar patch centre (48,64). Run both for another 180 seconds.
predictedTradeoff: Amoebae eat Sprinters and other small cells. Fewer grazers of sugar could leave more sugar, or the Amoebae could find little to catch. Either result is possible.
confounds: The copy controls the starting state at 120 s. After the Amoebae arrive, every encounter and random draw can differ between the copies, so one pair is not proof of a general effect. The Amoebae's own carbon is logged as an external input.

all.label: Both copies ran 180 s after the copy
Two Amoebae arrived in copy B
